decision.rationale: I recommend approving a provisional credit of 244.15 EUR. Two purchases at QUAYSIDE CLOTHING (MER-000042) on card CRD-000021 were both posted on 2026-08-19 for 24415 minor units each: TXN-007841 (2026-08-18T21:20:21Z) and the disputed TXN-007842 (2026-08-18T21:23:21Z). Both postings carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008056. That authorisation was a single approval for 24415, made online and passed 3-D Secure authentication. So one authorisation was posted twice. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 66 days after posting, which is inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The ledger shows no refund at this merchant for either posting. Under duplicate-same-authorisation, the extra posting is credited. The amount is 244.15 EUR, one posting and not both, which is well below the 3,000 EUR provisional credit limit and matches the amount claimed.
